dedupe_keys.name: dataset the impact of high voltage circuit breaker condition on power system reliability indices

description: Grant Jordon at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology publishes condition measurements and outage histories for high-voltage circuit breakers in Iceland's transmission grid. The deposit describes eighty-three trip-coil-current measurements and life histories for 464 breakers. Two Excel files separate condition data from survival data. Zenodo published the collection in August 2024 under CC BY 4.0, with free public access. The observation period, waveform sampling interval, censoring rules and detailed field definitions remain unknown from the public description. These limits require checking before fitting failure or survival models. The measurements can support breaker-condition calibration and power-system reliability simulations. The separately reviewed HVCB TCC Twin software explicitly links this dataset as related evidence. No existing catalogue parent explicitly covers the collection. The workbooks and reported histories were not downloaded or independently checked.
